database.note: Container CPU is point sampled; lock waiters are instantaneous. Cumulative database CPU and lock wait duration are unavailable from standard PostgreSQL views.

instrumentation.note: Separate wall times for sender journal writes and fsyncs, database polling including Docker stats, and synchronous trace emission. The recovery scan's sample-membership lookup and indirect scheduling or I/O effects are not separately timed; concurrent work can overlap, so these are not a throughput correction.

latency.clockPrecision: JavaScript Date and PostgreSQL timestamp read at millisecond precision

environment.saturation: single Docker stats sample; peak saturation unmeasured
